arStrings.szText: A pilgrim, new to Skovos, faces the locals' ire.

I have rescued the pilgrim Bnatros from an angry mob. He wishes to meet with his fellow pilgrims in another part of the city. Adoné and I will escort Bnatros there and protect him from further attacks.
